scheme_name: Intellectual Property Right Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme
other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a registered micro, small or medium enterprise
Must have a valid Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) or Udyam Registration certificate
benefits_summary: Grants up to ₹1 crore for IP facilitation centres and reimbursement up to ₹5 lakh for foreign patents, ₹1 lakh for domestic patents, ₹2 lakh for GI registration and ₹15,000 for design registration.
documents_required: Udyog Aadhaar Memorandum (UAM) or Udyam Registration certificate
